clock: Public non-streaming request through complete validated output; includes session/network/admission/polling. Not TTFT or GPU decode time.

baseline.p95_note: Not reported with fewer than20 observations.

after.p95_note: Not reported with fewer than20 observations.

limitations: All attempts and failure latencies are retained. Success-only latency is explicitly separate; no client submission retries.
Original phase labels are preserved; actual phase uses scientific start/end timestamps because file-based phase changes can lag.
No scientific correctness, production SLA or unseen burst coverage is inferred from this bounded synthetic workload.
